newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 30.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
The Conservatives could give parents and teachers the right to set up their own schools. The charter schools would be independent, run by the teachers themselves and sponsored by local businesses.
CRACKDOWN PLAN TO BEAT CREST BACKLOG
Firms that use Crest for share dealing could face fines if bargains they input are not settled on time. The action was proposed as a huge backlog of unsettled bargains had built up within the system.
SIGNAL AT GREEN FOR A SPEED-UP IN THE BIG RAILWAY SELL-OFF

OPRAF is to oversee the sell off of the remaining seven rail passenger franchises by March. The majority have been divested into private hands over the last year. The "sell-off" while hailed a success has cost the taxpayer 3.7 billion stg in subsidies.
STERLING SLIPS AS FOCUS TURNS TO SHARES

All eyes were on the FTSE to see whether it could push past Friday's all-time intra-day high. In the foreign exchange market the pound failed to hold on to the surge which had taken it to its best position since 1992.
